## Checklist

- [ ] `.venv/bin/python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] New logic in `core/` has a unit test (or: why not)
- [ ] New user-facing strings have a `_PT_EN` entry in `ui/i18n.py`
      — otherwise they ship as Portuguese to English users
- [ ] No media, build output or personal files committed
- [ ] `flet` version unchanged, or bumped in `requirements.txt` **and**
      `pyproject.toml` together (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
